meta.title: A round T&C file from another company's folder is accepted
gaps: The plan does not verify vendor notifications or whether the attachment is stored or signed for invited vendors.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown
the part about “pdf” is outside what an API plan on a sourcing event checks

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
